metadata-card.applies_when: Final native patch submission with full output contract
metadata-card.instruction: Include every required field in the submitted arguments. Set schema_version to are.patch-set-candidate/v1 and authority_effect to none. Copy the supplied base and file hashes exactly. Include the complete replacement source.
metadata-card.provenance: ZTH correction-card structure; GLM analysis H2

neutral-card.instruction: Review the task and the inspected material before returning the proposal. Keep the answer focused on the requested change. Use the supplied output structure and provide the complete replacement source. Do not report tests as executed.

boundary-card.applies_when: Final submission for archive or retention fixtures

instructions.archive: Apply the inspected boundary rules explicitly: validate ranges, reject a start inside a surrogate pair, move an interior end backward, reject nonempty reads with no progress, and allow the empty slice at EOF. Preserve UTF-16 offsets.
instructions.retention: Apply the inspected history rules explicitly: allow empty history, validate every exchange before masking, require nonempty unique call IDs, require positional result matches and tool roles, and preserve recent content and old-content recovery metadata.

boundary-card.provenance: ZTH correction-card structure; GLM analysis H3
